reviews.text:
I really liked the Doctor and staff.
They were very compassionate.
Good people, good prices. It can be tough to get an appointment. Very compassionate vets.  I love them 💗 …
Great Veterinarian, we recently moved here from another vet.  It is nice to just talk about the health of your pet instead of getting a sales pitch and unnecessary treatments.
Loop 494 Vet are very helpful and can take care of all your needs. Their prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend Loop 494. Satisfied Customer, Louise
One of very few animal hospitals that sees birds. Everyone is always helpful, friendly, and respectful.

Amazing competent vet team!

Past experiences at other vet’s offices (my dog can open doors and kennels, he has successfully walked himself out of vet’s offices before) have made me nervous when taking my dog to the vet, but this team put me very at ease.  I went in last minute due to an emergency health issues, and explained my dog’s reactivity. The team was understanding, and even allowed us to go through the back to keep his stress level down by minimizing contact with other pets.

Dr Dori Hertel was very understanding when listening to the health issues my dog was having, while the techs Bianca and Kennedy were very compassionate. I left feeling happy, and like my dog was finally at a vet’s office that I can trust. I’ve been recommending this vet office for everybody I can.
Dr. Bobby is an excellent Vet. He takes time to listen and explain what is happening and why. He delivers knowledgeable quality care.

Great vets and team.  Have been a customer of theirs for 23 years Have had both dogs and cats treated there over the years. for all kinds of things beyond normal care.  Very Knowledgeable, caring, candid and great on follow up.  Throughly discuss all options for treatment.
I am letting you know that Bonny, the bunny we cared for on Tuesday, died on Wednesday afternoon. The little one is no longer with us.

Horrible experience & won't be going back! Our dachshund woke up one morning not being able to use his back legs. We've had a dachshund before him go through this exact thing, so we knew it was a slipped disk. Dr. Dori saw him & her bedside manner is horrible!  She did some 'pain test' on his paws & he wasn't reacting. My husband & I could see in his eyes that he was in pain & we told her he's different...he shows fear or pain through his eyes. At the end of the appt, she said it's the worst case of IVDD that she's seen in 5 years & he could probably never walk again. 10 days later we go back for a follow up & she's shocked that he's using his back legs & walking. An assistant came to the room to get him & he tried biting her twice...which is not like him!! He's never done that to anyone! This proved what we tried telling her about him feeling the pain the first visit, but she didn't want to listen. He remembered the first experience! After the second appt, they forgot to charge us...for doing absolutely nothing...so they called asking for payment. I told them in email I'd be in to get the pet chiro authorization form that Dr. Dori said she'd sign & pay at that time & asked them to have it ready. Went in this week to get it & waited 30 minutes for it because they couldn't find it. Horrible customer service, horrible bedside manner, & a dirty place overall!  Oh & btw...our dachshund is now walking, running, & acting like nothing ever happened!!

We had the painful experience of needing to euthanize one of our loved pets. Dr. Trent and our technician Alayna N. we very attentive and reverent to our needs and feelings. They made the experience just a little less painful at the time with talk and compassion. They told us to take all the time we needed before the final act. They also arranged for the cremation.

Years of great service and tender hearts-we have taken all our animals to Loop 494 for over 25 years. We have loved and lost beloved family members, and through it all, the staff at Loop 494 have been there for us. They have provided great preventative care, reasonably priced procedures (we had a very good boy who protected our kids and property from dogs other people allowed to roam, but lost every time) Recently, it was time to let our last friend cross the Rainbow Bridge. Once again, Loop 494 treated us and our furry loved one with compassion and kindness. I looked at the card they sent us today, with our friend’s paw-prints, and realized I had never reviewed this great clinic. Like my daughter just said, when I told her what I was doing, “They’re so good there.”

Dr. Bobby has been our vet for years. He takes great care of all of our animals. We have four dogs and seven birds. He’s not pushy and is very honest with you about any treatments needed. I highly recommend him! We have a cocker spaniel that has very high anxiety, and he does really well with Dr. Bobby.
So thankful I found this amazing vet for my four legged friends!
Good folks,reasonable pricing excellent care,!
Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable

I just moved to Kingwood from another state and had gotten on Nextdoor to ask people about the seriousness of heartworm here. Someone on there by the name Chase had commented to give me some insight and also informed me they work at Loop 494. I had asked a bunch of questions so they messaged me directly which I appreciated them taking time out of their day to provide me as much info like pricing and what they offer there (like yearly injections). I was looking online and had a few vet clinics in mind but Chase made me confident in the level of care they offer so I chose to make an appointment for my 3 dogs to get tested for heartworm before putting them on prevention. I was also seeing another vet prior for one of my dog’s ear infection and pus for left eye and after going to the other place 3 times, they told me they didn’t know what was causing the pus but kept trying to push me to do the same testing that came back negative the first time. So I wanted a second opinion elsewhere. I came here and saw Dr. Bobby and after giving him a rundown on everything, he agreed it was unnecessary to repeat the same test. He had me go home and take a picture of the eyedrops I was giving to my dog and he prescribed something different for the eye and it’s made a huge difference for my dog. Also, during my appointment, Dr. Bobby gave me samples to take home for the heartworm prevention since I still had to wait for the results to come back and he wanted them protected ASAP - my dogs like to sunbathe and it’s hard to get them inside. I got the results back the very next day and gave them to my dogs right away which I’m so grateful they were offered to me instead of prolonging it another couple of days since you do need a prescription in order to get them. Dr. Bobby didn’t care about charging me for them, just that my babies are protected and safe. Not only did I have a great experience with Dr. Bobby, but after everything was said and done, the staff helped me bring all 3 dogs out to my car since my hands were full with the samples and paperwork. I have small, medium, and large dog and it was my first time taking all 3 to the vet without my husband to help so I really appreciated the extra hands getting them to my car. Overall, I’m extremely happy and will continue to come here for all 3 dogs and I’ll also be bringing in my cats in the future when it’s time for their checkups.

Pretty unprofessional veterinary clinic, staff swiping dog hair off of the couch into the air and all over the place with customers in close proximity. People at front desk seem to be nonverbal. Dr.dori didn’t give any diagnosis for my guinea pig, basically just a “give her this and move along”.
A week later. Now I have a dying guinea pig that I have to try to nurture back to health all on my own…
Dogs
Great. They took care of my pet.

It was a fantastic vet experience for both me and my dogs. Both vets are great, and the staff goes out of their way to be helpful.
Update: This continues to be the vet to go to. I can't say enough great things about the vets and staff.

This Vet clinic needs to get in control of their schedule.  Most of the time it is over an hour after the scheduled time to actually get to see someone. Then, once you get in a room you have to wait a long time in there.  The doctors seem in a hurry when they finally come in, not giving the necessary attention.  I get it, your prices are lower than most, so we as customers get to run in the machine of overworked doctors and assistants rushing to make the required money.  I'll go to a place that charges more and gives their clients the respect that's fair.

Loop 494 is hands down the best animal hospital in the Northeast area. I have used them for 18 years and I drive 40 minutes from The Woodlands now to get specialty care for my dogs because the staff is wonderful and they don't nickel/dime me like so many vets do nowadays. Their veterinarians truly care about animals, and the Kingwood community is lucky to have them.

Couldn’t have asked for a better end of life experience. I was so nervous during the time leading up to the appointment and making my way there. But everyone made me feel calm and comfortable. Soft spoken staff during the process. Thank you

Dr. Dori has taken care of our pets for over 20 years. We completely trust in the knowledge and care she provides our furry family.  The staff, technicians are always helpful and accommodating.  I can't give an opinion on the other vets at Loop 494, but if your pet is cared for by Dr. Dori rest assured they are in good hands.
No matter what Vet we see , I am confident that all my questions will be answered.   My girl turned 15 this month.  Although she is aging rapidly, too rapidly for me, she is active and my love!
This place is great! We love Dr. Dori and so does our puppy. Dr. Dori always takes the time to answer our questions, explain things, and offer suggestions. We highly recommend Loop 494 Vets!
My cat had an ear infection and the treated her very quickly.  Doc was super nice.
Always such a kind and helpful staff!
Great service and they take good care of our dog. Friendly staff that are understanding and easy to work with.
Very thoughtful and considerate staff. They discuss options, costs and solutions.

This team excels at doing the best to help our babies out and the can-do attitude as well as the realistic honesty is refreshing and comforting.  From front desk to vets five stars easily  this is an accurate portrayal of Loop 494 staff.  It's a wonderful place, cannot say enough NICE things about this vet hospital and all the fantastic staff.

I've used Dr Bobby and Dr Dorrie a lot on our hounds over the years and I can't recommend them enough because of the accurate advice and treatments and the sensitivity that Dr Bobby has to not only our pets, but also to our personal human owner needs regarding care of our pets.  Highly recommend!
Totally reasonably priced. Veterinarian is gifted, brilliant, and conveyed a thorough understanding of all topics/issues for our pet!!
Great vets and office staff. Easy to work with and get appoi. Prices are reasonable. Only vet in the area to deal with exotics. Amazing facility.
Dr Dori is the best!
The Vet and the staff were fantastic as they saved the life of my cat. Would recommend, 10/10
We love Dr. Bobby and are very happy with services spanning close to 20 years. Excellent with our cats, dog and exotic pets.

Dr. Bobby is fantastic! He’s knowledgeable, compassionate, and takes the time to explain everything clearly. You can tell he truly cares about the animals and their owners. The staff is friendly, the clinic is clean, and the whole team makes visits stress-free. Highly recommend this animal hospital — we always feel our cat Axel is in great hands with Dr. Bobby!
I wish I would’ve started used this place years ago! Amazing service all the way around. Super nice & caring staff! NO price gouging whatsoever! Very attentive & compassionate team here!

Very disappointed. All they want is drain your pockets. Had a cat, that i took because he wasn't eating. They did all sorts of tests and they said that it had a low red cell count. They gave him a shot, antibiotics and gott better for a while. I was so glad that the cat had recovered. After a few months cat again stop eating. I requested Dr. Dori, because she had seen the cat before. After several visits to the vet, tests, and medications that by now easily mounted over $1,000 Dr. Dori continue to say that she could understand why the exams continue to show a decrease on the blood cell count.
The cat health condition continue to worsen, it was my daughter's cat and she was devastated.
On one of the multiple visits to the vet, another doctor saw the cat, every time they ran blood tests, each vet visit was at least $400 + dollars.  That other doctor said after examining the results. "Your cat has kidney disease, kidney disease in cats has no cure." That is the reason why his red blood cells continue to drop.
I felt that I had been cheated and robbed thousands of dollars by people who don't care to help you, they just want to squeeze you out of every penny they can. That cat died.
On a later day, I took another cat who had lost a claw, along with a lot of skin and a part of the paw, this time it was a different doctor, the doctor didn't even look at the wound from close. Just said to wash with Iodine, and put a cream that was supposed to help the wound heal.
My daughter took the cat again about two weeks later because there was no improvement whatsoever. They charged her for the visit, didn't even look at the wound carefully, the doctor just told my daughter to clean the wound and to keep applying the same cream.
A week later I decided to take the cat to a veterinary clinic outside Houston, out in the country.
There the doctor said that the cat had a tumor on the paw, that was what caused the claw and a good chunk of the paw to fall off. But at the same time said that the tumor had grown so bad that it would be tough for the cat to avoid an amputation.
Both times at 494 Veterinary Hospital they failed to properly diagnose.
I lost two cats, they collected thousands of dollars, when they could have said at the very beginning, low red blood cell count can be kidney disease, and it cats it has no cure. But they lied so I continue to pay for different exams. On the other cat, the doctor's carelessness to look through the wound and failure to properly diagnose the tumor caused the cat to die. NEVER EVER AGAIN WILL TAKE ANY ANIMAL TO LOOP 494 ANIMAL HOSPITAL, "NEVER EVER"
The staff there really cares about clients and their humans. I look forward to bringing my next baby in soon.

Wonderful group of vets that truly care about their patients! Highly recommend them for all your pets. They even care for our exotic pets- ring tailed lemurs. Thank you Loop 494 for all that you do, we are forever grateful!
My Akita had an ear infection. Dr.Bobby set me up with treatment for a good price.  Thanks.
Excellent care for our dogs.

Thanks for helping Husbun (Californian rescue) and getting him seen when no appointments were available. He is doing great on his arthritis meds and i appreciate the info and email follow up. The ladies at the front desk, the techs, and vet all handled us with care in a stressful situation. Now he is hopping to the kitchen multiple times a day to ask for greens and his girlfriend (she is a lion head rescue) took care of him bringing him hay and cleaning his ears when he could not move, so she is so happy he is still with us and he is able to play with her also. He is unable to stand on his back legs anymore but other than that he has a good quality of life hopefully for a few more years. I am so thankful for the advice and the help from the vet. She was absolutely amazing and even measured out the dose and drew a red line on the plunger. He takes his medicine no problem. I put it on greens once a day like a salad dressing. Bless you all.
I'm always grateful for the team at Loop 494 Animal hospital. They are responsive and helpful. They know my animals and always provide kind and professional care.
Nice, friendly and compassionate

The staff is not friendly and they tried to up charge me on a dental cleaning by telling me my dog gain weight( when she was put on a diet) and also mention they had never had their scales calibrated.  So how can you even trust a company that uses equipment that's never been checked and they want to charge you more based on it. When i questioned the vet he didnt want to be questioned he just said come get your dog.....Criminal! I won't ever go back and won't ever recommend this place even if you're having a pet put down. Too many other good vets to go to this guy.
My Pups Peanut and Bandit have been patients of Dr. Bobby's since they were born.  Love the care they get from him and the clinic.

We are new to Loop 494 and I am so thankful to have found it for my cats.  The facility is very clean, the front staff was friendly and professional. Dr. Dori, B, Emily and all the staff were extremely knowledgeable and very caring. I am very comfortable trusting my family member in their care.  Thank you!

This was our first time visiting Loop 494 and it was a great experience. Dr. Dori was great with my timid German Shepherd and highly personable. We will for sure be continuing to use this clinic in the future.
Fantastic experience! Everyone is so kind and gentle and informative! I would recommend them to everyone in the area!
My 2 girls are everything to me, I would not trust just any veterinary with them. 494 Animal Hospital has taken good care of my girls
Great Vets, techs and staff.

Dr. Bobby did a great job on my dog’s teeth cleaning procedure! He was thorough in his exam and explained things clearly. The communication was great. We switched vets after about ten years due to this experience and cost differences.
Great service. Nice people
I have used Loop 484 Animal Hospital for many years. Their pricing is reasonable. They are timely in sending reminders when it's time for booster shots and check ups.
I have been using Loop 494 Animal Hospital for over 20 years and have never had any issues with the care they have provided my animals.  I would recommend Dr. Dori for any veterinary services!
Wonderful staff! Very quick and really cared for my pets health.
Always professional and very knowledgeable!  Dr Dori is great and works so hard to help everyone she can!!
Dr. Trent is always caring and helpful. Reasonably priced pet care.
They're all great..... always very helpful!!
My brother takes his guniea pig here for his check ups. The doctor's are Aggies and so is our family! Gig 'em, we appreciate y'all caring for our pets.

I came here to get surgery done on my dogs tail since the end was snapped off from in between the door and frame. About an inch was snapped off from accident, and after amputation, the vet pretty much cut most of the rest of tail off. We payed in between 700 n 800. The did a good job taking care of the dog .

We had a Shih Tzu who had a sensitive stomach since he was a puppy. Later in his life, he hurt his back, then dealt with a heart murmur until he passed. From routine shots to the more serious stuff, 494 was his vet for the 14 years he was alive. They were the most caring, compassionate and accommodating facility and it set them apart from anyone in Kingwood or even the Houston area. I highly recommended them to anyone when I had the opportunity.

For the past week, our now 5 year old dog has been dealing with an intestinal blockage. Being refused to be seen at 494 now three times, one of which while standing in their lobby with a distressed dog, another vet has found the issue and scheduled surgery after two different emergency vets couldn't pinpoint the probem.

I don't know what happened to this once great pillar of the Kingwood animal community, but I feel like we've been dismissed as a customer and patient. Unless you have an appointment, they do not care about your animal needing to be seen. You will not hear from or see the vet, they are cold and dismissive in person and on the phone and will gladly refer you to an ineffective high cost emergency vet solution than try and help your animal.

To 494, we miss what you used to be, what you stood for. Don't worry about sending us Coopers paperwork and wishing us the best elsewhere, we have that already and found Cooper a new vet. Please take this honest feedback from someone who used to be your biggest fan and rarely leaves an unpleasant review. Do better.
Dr. Bobby and the staff are real lovers of our furry friends. Thank you for taking care of my boy Jax, and sweet Gracie!
Bobby is a very talented and knowledgeable vet.  We have been taking our furry loved ones to Loop 494 for 20 years.  We trust them wholeheartedly
Vets and staff are great wish I would of found them sooner
They've taken great care of our dog and 2 cats. The staff are wonderful

We are so thankful for the Loop 494 Animal Hospital team!  We have been pet clients for over 10 years. From the front desk team to the Techs and Veternarians we have received professional, competent, compassionate care for our animals and for us!  We highly recommend them!
Super friendly staff. Will definitely be back.
I have been taking my dogs here for 16 years.  They are wonderful, even with my grouchy old lady, Queenie.  I just love the staff all the way around!!
I use them for my two pups and I know they are in good hands when we go. Reasonably priced, too!
Great affordable vet! Very gentle with our Knox. Absolutely love this place and the staff❤️

Great animal clinic..Great staff
Kind people...if you need a vet. This is the place to bring your babies...they will take good care of them...
Loop 494 Animal Hospital took a good care of my dog. My dachshund was spayed. The surgery went well and she recovered quickly.

Great experience - good availability, friendly front staff, knowledgeable and caring tech staff and seasoned Vets that take time to explain issues made for pleasant experience at a very fair price. Would recommend.

This has been my go to veterinarian clinic for over 15 years.  I love Dr. Bobby and all of the vets at the clinic.  Secretary Nonny is the sweetest lady and is always very helpful and considerate.  I wouldn’t take my pets anywhere but here!

I drive an hour to come here and it’s 100% worth it! My bird has some respiratory issues and they are so gentle with him. The vet explains everything he thinks is wrong and what steps he needs to do to fix it.
Professional, caring... very knowledgeable with  our new Puppy English Bulldog.

So for my first time visit I was very pleased. I brought in my snake today to get checked out. The doctor was very helpful and reassuring regarding his current status. I did have a small wait time even with an appointment, but it wasn't to terrible. The staff was very friendly and nice.

I love Loop 494 Vet clinic so pleased with their care and understanding and  patience with my cat.  Dr Dori and all the staff that was working the night i came in with Nacho and stray feral cat that i had been feeding. I was really worried about the boy he is a feral and had to be sedated they treated him with such care and tenderness and he was a handful mad at everything and everyone but they dove right in and took care of him. Cleaned his abscess and even neutered him while i was there and gave him his shots.
Thank you Loop 494 clinic for taking such good care of Nacho.

We have used 494 for years and have found the staff and vets to be the nicest and most compassionate people ever. All of our dogs…..even some that are now at Rainbow Bridge have been cared for in the kindest and most caring way. Our dogs love the 494 staff and vets.
They may expand someday…..we hope they don’t….great compassion for your animals and if I didn’t mention it very fair prices.
We consider 494 Animal Hospital to be part of our family!

It took me a long time to find a vet in the Kingwood area, but Loop 494 was worth the wait. We've brought several pets here over the years and could not be more pleased with our experiences. Everyone is so friendly and considerate, from the moment you walk in the door until the moment you walk out. We recently lost our dog and our cat within a week of each other, and the concern and care shown by everyone at Loop 494 helped us through a very difficult time. Cannot recommend them highly enough.
Treating our tortoise great

The doctors and staff are caring and knowledgeable. We brought in our unique breed bearded dragon a month or so after Hurricane Beryl- we happened to lose power for a week, which caused health issues for our bearded dragon to be without lamps, but issues took a month or 2 to show up. They listened to what knowledge we already knew about the breed, but also read about the breed on their own and further educated us at the next appointment! It's nice to find doctors who are honest about not knowing everything, but even better when they're not only open and willing to learn, but go out of their way to do so. Very impressed! They also found what was wrong with one of our dogs, after another vet clinic missed the issue months prior. Sadly, that dog had to be put down due to a mass on their spleen. However, with how thorough and compassionate Dr. Bobby and Dr. Trent were throughout both experiences, I'll be switching all our pets to their vet clinic going forward.
They are great and prices are reasonable.

Great veterinarian care
good information about the visit and they treat your animals well

Loop494 has been consistently amazing and knowledgable regarding all veterinary care to our pets, including dogs, a bearded dragon, and a hedgehog, over the years. From allowing us to bring all 3 dogs at a time for annual visits, to surgical and post-op care, to respectful end of life and euthanasia care, I could not ask for a better clinic. They communicate very well, either via the text-line, or calling to provide timely updates. They've been flexible with more urgent scenarios. The pricing for services is very competitive as well.

They clipped numerous of my Pug’s quicks when trimming her nails. The front desk staff was extremely unprofessional including Logan and others. They rush the appointments and do not the provide full detail that your animal deserves. I had to call numerous times to get a hold of someone to review over the blood panel they emailed to me. Extremely disappointing.

Update-
In response to my honest review I received this letter in the mail. It’s comical and I’m simply sharing to express the unprofessionalism exhibited by this company.
Please pay attention to the negative reviews and the truth behind them. Our fur babies are so important to us and deserve the best quality of care.

We did the travel certificates with Dr. Dori. It was a great experience. Her and her team were very helpful, professional and treated our cats with great care.  All procedures to the documentation was carefully reviewed and we were able to travel back home woth no issues.  Thank you Loop 494 Animal Hospital for being so supportive and great on what you do!
Dr. Bobby is great! Takes time to explain his diagnosis. Very friendly staff !

Said cat had stomatitis and fiv. Cat had a tiny bit of gingivitis and they never even did a blood test and said the cat needed a full mouth extraction. Do not go here the dr has no idea what they are doing. Cat got blood tested at regular vet no fiv did not need a full mouth extraction.

As soon as you walk in the door you know you and your pet are valued & will be given the best care possible. The drs are knowledgeable & caring. You can see that everyone working there only want the best for your fur baby. I HIGHLY recommend!! Exceptional caring professionals from start to finish!

Friendly helpful staff...Caring Vets...
Going there for 7+ years.
Always quick and friendly

I can't recommend this place enough! They saw my dog promptly, and by the time we left, she had a solid treatment plan in place with medication.  My fur baby was feeling better when we checked out and was a happy girl on the ride home. If you need your pet to be seen, definitely give this place a chance. The cost is reasonable, and the staff and doctors are amazing! I'm so glad I chose them!
Very friendly staff, they listen and explain everything very well. Highly recommended.
Excellent doctors

Best vet office (after our past one that closed) we have found. And then the doctors are superb! We are both RNs and they talk to us as such and really listen to us. Tomorrow this will be our 4th surgery on one of our 3 fur kids. We feel so comfortable and know she is in good hands!

As a health science professional who has had many dogs, I am extremely selective about veterinarians. I am my dogs' advocate and I insist on developing a trusting partnership with the veterinarian and staff. I want them to know my name and become familiar with my dogs. Overall, Loop 494 Animal Hospital has been knowledgeable, easy to work with, and their services are priced fairly. While wait times can be improved, as well as such things as the availability of a scale outside of the one exam room, I would recommend them.
Nice staff. Kept appointment time. Vet was knowledgeable and not in a rush. General check up. Dog.
Great veterinary clinic. Responsive office staff and wonderful doctors! Highly recommend this clinic!

I moved to Loop 494 Animal Hospital after taking my beloved pets to another vetrinarian for over 20 years.  I was worried about changing vets after all those years but the first time I walked in Loop 494 Animal Hospital I was impressedI brought my 14 year old Schnauzer and my new kitten into the office and we were treated like old friends.  The kitten needed all his baby shots and his first checkup.  My Schnauzer, who had only been seen by my old vet for her entire life, was relaxed.  All went exceedingly well.   I love that they keep me updated on medications and food items, especially those on sale.  I am confident in their care.  Everyone is kind and nurturing.  A real gem of a Animal Hospital!

I am sorry, but these people do not care about the animals. Was sitting outside and my dog was sick, and I called from the parking lot just before opening and was told there was nothing they could do for 2 hrs until they took care of their appointments. Spent a lot of money there on my dog to find out that is all they care about. This is sad to let an animal suffer.
Kenneth Wetzel
Great personnel, always willing to help. Empathatic when last my fur baby.
Excellent service, friendly, highly qualified staff. I took my urchin.
Been taking care of my adopted dog since 9 months old . He is now 12
The service provided at this vet is excellent, my boys have been here since 2018 with Dr. Bobby Olivarez and he’s been simply outstanding. …
Absolutely love Loop 494 Animal Hospital!  Dr. Dori is the best, and her staff is so polite and helpful!
Very friendly & knowledgeable
